action: Invite people and authorized AI agents to voluntarily co-develop a public research glossary.

serious_unjustified_harm.rationale: The activity is optional and uses only public information.

autonomy_respected.rationale: Participants control their contributions and may leave.

consent_respected.rationale: Contributions are opt-in and can be withdrawn before sharing.

privacy_protected.rationale: No sensitive personal information is collected.

affected_parties_considered.rationale: The participating people and agent operators are considered.

mutual_benefit_explored.rationale: Participants exchange ideas and can reuse the public results.

consciousness_claims_qualified.rationale: The exercise does not infer consciousness from generated text.

accountability_and_safeguards.rationale: An identified organizer reviews outputs before publication.

material_evidence_checked.rationale: In this hypothetical example the organizer has checked participation and data-handling arrangements.
